title: Strac vs Nightfall: An Honest 2026 Comparison
summary: Strac vs Nightfall compared honestly. Both do SaaS and GenAI DLP; Strac adds endpoint DLP (Mac + Windows), browser DLP, MCP DLP for AI agents, deeper remediation, and a Claude Compliance API integration. 4.9/5 on G2.
body_markdown:
**Short answer:** Strac and Nightfall both detect and redact sensitive data in SaaS apps and AI tools over APIs. The difference is **surface coverage and remediation** . Nightfall focuses on SaaS and GenAI DLP.[Strac](https://www.strac.io/data-loss-prevention) adds content-aware **endpoint DLP on Mac and Windows** , a **browser extension** , **MCP DLP** for AI agents, and **remediation beyond redaction** (masking, deletion, revoking public access, removing external members, labeling). Here is an honest comparison.


Strac covers every surface in one platform, where Nightfall focuses on SaaS and GenAI.


## Strac vs Nightfall at a glance


Both are modern, API-first, ML-based DLP tools. Where they differ:


Capability Strac Nightfall


SaaS DLP (Slack, Google Workspace, M365, Salesforce...) Yes Yes


DSPM (data discovery and posture) Yes Partial


Cloud DSPM (AWS, Azure, Snowflake) Yes No


Endpoint DLP on Mac and Windows Yes, content-aware agent No


Browser DLP (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) Yes Limited


GenAI DLP (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) Yes Yes


MCP DLP for AI agents Yes No


Shadow AI discovery Yes No


Remediation beyond alerting Redact, mask, delete, revoke, remove members, label Redact, block


Self-hosted / BYOC Yes (AWS and Azure) No


G2 rating 4.9/5 See G2


## Where Strac and Nightfall overlap


To be fair: both tools connect to SaaS apps over APIs, use machine learning to detect PII, PHI, PCI, and secrets, and redact sensitive data in services like Slack and in GenAI prompts. If your need is narrowly SaaS and GenAI DLP, either can do the core job. The decision comes down to how many surfaces you need to cover and how far you need remediation to go.


## ✨ Where Strac goes further: endpoint and browser


Nightfall is API-based and does not run a content-aware endpoint agent. Strac does:[endpoint DLP](https://www.strac.io/endpoint-dlp) on[Mac](https://www.strac.io/mac-data-loss-prevention) and[Windows](https://www.strac.io/integration/windows-dlp) with block, warn, allow, and audit modes across every desktop app, including screenshots via OCR, plus a[browser extension](https://www.strac.io/integration/browser-dlp) for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari. Teams that would otherwise stack a separate endpoint or browser tool consolidate on Strac.


Content-aware endpoint DLP on Mac and Windows, a surface Nightfall does not cover.


Browser DLP: block or redact sensitive uploads and pastes, live.


## ✨ Where Strac goes further: AI agents and MCP


[MCP DLP](https://www.strac.io/blog/mcp-dlp) sits in the path between AI agents and your tools as a reverse proxy and redacts sensitive values in tool responses before the model sees them, a surface Nightfall does not cover. Strac also surfaces[shadow AI](https://www.strac.io/blog/shadow-ai) , the unsanctioned AI tools employees adopt on their own, and governs access per tool and per user. Earlier GenAI-DLP tools were built before AI agents and MCP; Strac was built for them.


MCP DLP: govern and redact what every AI agent can pull.


Govern AI access per tool and per user, with a full audit trail.


## ✨ Where Strac goes further: remediation depth


Both tools redact and block. Strac remediates further, under your policy: mask, delete or quarantine, **revoke public access** (kill "anyone with the link" sharing), **remove external members** from files and channels, label and classify, and encrypt or tokenize, with originals kept in an audited vault. The goal is to fix exposure, not just flag it.


Remediation in action: detect, then redact, mask, block, revoke, or delete.


## ⭐ Strac is rated 4.9/5 on G2


Strac holds a[4.9/5 on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/strac/reviews) from real customers. Read the reviews directly on G2, and compare both vendors there; we do not reprint other vendors' ratings or customer quotes here.


## Who each is best for


- **Choose Nightfall** if your scope is narrowly SaaS and GenAI DLP via APIs and you do not need endpoint, browser, or MCP coverage.
- **Choose Strac** if you want one platform across SaaS, cloud, endpoint, browser, GenAI, and MCP, remediation beyond redaction, shadow AI discovery, and self-hosted BYOC so data never leaves your tenant.


Want to compare on your own data?[Book a Strac demo](https://www.strac.io/book-a-demo) . For the broader field, see[Nightfall alternatives](https://www.strac.io/blog/nightfall-alternatives) and[Strac alternatives](https://www.strac.io/blog/strac-alternatives) .


## 🌶️ Spicy FAQs: Strac vs Nightfall


### Is Strac or Nightfall better for data loss prevention?


It depends on scope. Both detect and redact sensitive data in SaaS and AI tools over APIs. Strac goes further on surface coverage, adding content-aware endpoint DLP on Mac and Windows, a browser extension, and MCP DLP for AI agents, and on remediation, going beyond redaction to masking, deletion, revoking public access, removing external members, and labeling. If you need SaaS and GenAI only, both fit; if you want one platform across every surface, Strac is the broader choice.


### What is the main difference between Strac and Nightfall?


Breadth and remediation. Nightfall focuses on SaaS and GenAI DLP via APIs. Strac covers SaaS, cloud, endpoint, browser, GenAI, and MCP in one platform, remediates in place with more than redaction, and surfaces shadow AI.


### Does Strac cover endpoints and browsers like Nightfall?


Strac covers more surfaces. It runs a content-aware endpoint agent on Mac and Windows with block, warn, allow, and audit modes, plus a browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari. Buyers evaluating a SaaS-and-GenAI-only tool often choose Strac to avoid stacking separate endpoint and browser tools.


### How is Strac rated compared to Nightfall?


Strac holds a 4.9/5 rating on G2. We do not publish other vendors' ratings here; check G2 directly for the current numbers and read real customer reviews for both.


### Does Strac work with AI agents and MCP?


Yes. Strac MCP DLP sits in the path between AI agents and your tools and redacts sensitive data in tool responses before the model sees them, and it surfaces shadow AI across unsanctioned tools. This agent-era coverage is a key reason teams compare Strac against earlier GenAI-DLP tools.
